<!-- pr-reviewer: 279fbb3c3b9b7ad343a3aef04375882126abfabb -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blockers. The PR merges cleanly with upstream main.

What looks good:

- The CPU default, detection fallback, floor and cap match #2814.
- Explicit positive overrides retain their full range. Invalid values produce a diagnostic.
- The lane fixtures use a fixed budget. The process declaration and decision record are present.
- The PR leaves PROCESS_VERSION unchanged, as current upstream AGENTS.md requires.

Local results:

The tests ran in `.claude/worktrees/review-2837` after a trial merge with upstream main `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed in 273 seconds. All 196 unit tests and 22 integration tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with sccache enabled.
- `cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run`: passed. The source was 32 available CPUs. The budget was 32 jobs, with at most 16 lanes. Alone steps received 32 jobs.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: no heavy lane applies to this diff.

Extra suites run:

None required. The diff changes no test data, fixtures, goldens or import code.

Safety and evidence:

This PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, gouge checks or collision checks. No golden changed. Safety-tier mutation reruns do not apply. I did not change code or rerun mutations. The PR changes no UI, so screenshots do not apply.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: Full batch and release execution did not run. Windows and macOS did not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge note: this PR merges now at head `279fbb3c3b9b7ad343a3aef04375882126abfabb`.

- Class: no refresh. The head is the reviewed head, and it merges cleanly with `main`.
- Review: the `pr-reviewer` marker of mkinney's review agent on this head. A collaborator set `merge-ready`.
- This is a process PR (`Process change: yes`). The merging session opens the `PROCESS_VERSION` PR after this merge and comments on #681.
